rules.applicability: Evaluation
rules.notes: PA inactivity rule: at least 2 trading days with $50 or more net profit within every rolling 30-day window, otherwise the PA is closed. Measured continuously (each day the system checks the most recent 30-calendar-day lookback). Courtesy notifications on days 15 and 20 of inactivity; account moves to dormant phase.
